title: Kitchen
intro: The Kitchen board shows live tickets per kitchen station. Staff bump items through workflow stages and recall completed batches when needed.

sections.title: Kitchen board overview
steps: Select a kitchen station at the top if you have more than one.
Tickets appear in columns as orders are sent To kitchen from the floor.
sections.caption: Kitchen screen with station selector and board.

sections.title: Toolbar actions
steps: Complete all open marks every active ticket on this station as done.
Completed orders opens a list of finished batches with Recall.
View all dishes shows a running count of each dish still on the board.
Average time shows prep duration for completed items today.
sections.caption: Kitchen toolbar and average prep time.

sections.title: Ticket board
sections.intro: Each card is part of an order. Multi-part orders may use colored borders. Tap stages on a ticket to advance workflow.
steps: Read table or order type, invoice number, and dish lines on each ticket.
Tap a stage button to complete that kitchen step for the line items.
Large orders may split across multiple cards on the board.
sections.caption: Kitchen ticket board with order cards.
sections.note: Send at least one order To kitchen before capture so tickets appear on the board.
